chapter.verse: Pentekost pawikham ni a tun’ ciangin amaute khempeuh mun khatah a omkhawm uh hi.
Tua lai takin huihpi nung bangin vantung panin awging khat thakhatin hong suak a, amau tutna inn a dim sak hi.
Tua lai takin meikuang tawh kibang leiite kikhenin, amaute kiangah kilang uh a, amau a vekpi tungah tung kim uh a,
amaute khempeuh in Kha Siangtho tawh kidimin, Kha Siangtho in thu a piak bangin kam tuamtuam tawh thu a hilh uh hi.
Tua lai takin van nuai gam khempeuh panin a hong pai, Pasian a zahtak Judah mite Jerusalem khua-ah a om uh hi.
Tua awging a zak uh ciangin mihonpi kikhawm uh a, mi kim in ama kam ciat tawh thu a gen a zak ciangun lamdang a sa uh hi.
Amaute khempeuh in lamdang a sa uh a, lungmangin, “Hih thuhilhte khempeuh in Galile mite hilo ahi uh hiam?
Tua bang ahih leh, eite a tuamtuam i pian’pih kam tawh bang ci-in i za thei hiam?
Parthia mi a kipan Media mi, Elam mi, Mesopotamia gam, Judah gam, Kappadokia gam, Pontas gam, Asia gam,
Frigia gam, Pamfilia gam, Izipt gam, Sairin khua kimkot Libia gam sungah a teeng mite, Rom khua pan hong pai zinte,

Judah mi ahi zongin, Judah ngeina sungah a tum mite ahi zongin, Krete leh Arab ahi eite khempeuh in Pasian’ nalamdangte eite’ kam tawh hong gen uh i za hi!”a ci uh hi. Amaute khempeuh in lamdangsa-in lung-am uh a, “Bang ahi hiam?” ci-in khat leh khat a kikum uh hi.
Mi kimkhat in, “Hih mite in leenggahzu thak a kham uh hi,” ci-in a zahko uh hi.

Tua lai takin sawm leh khatte tawh Piter ding a, kiko-in tua mite kiangah thu a hilh inah: “Jerusalem khua-ah a teengte khempeuh leh Judah mite aw, note in hih thu na thei un la, ka thu a tel takin na ngai ta un.
Tu hun in zingsang nai kua ahih ciangin na up uh bangin hih mite in zukhamin a om kei uh hi.
Hih thute in kamsangpa Joel in a hilh ngeisa thu ahi hi.
‘A nunung nite ciangin Mi khempeuh tungah ka Kha ka bua ding hi. Na tapate na tanute un thu hilhkhol ding uh hi. Na tangvalte un mang a mu ding uh a, Na puteekte un mang a man’ ding uh hi.
Tua lai takin ka nasem pasal leh numeite tungah, Ka kha ka bua ding a, thu a hilhkhol ding uh hi.
Tunglam vantungah nalamdang ka lak ding a, Van nuai leitungah lim ka lak ding hi. Si tawh, meikuang tawh, meikhu tawh ka lak ding hi.
Topa’ Ni vanglian leh lamdang hong tun’ ma-in Ni hong mial ding a, Kha in sisan a suak ding hi.
Tua lai takin Topa’ min tawh thu a ngen peuhmahte in Gupna a ngah ding uh hi, ci-in Pasian in a gen hi,’ a ci hi.

“No Israel mite aw, hih thu na ngai ta un. No na theih uh mah bangin Pasian in Nazareth mi Zeisu tungah vangliatnate leh nalamdangte leh lungman’nate, note lakah hong hih theihna tawh Pasian in note kiangah tua Zeisu a dik hi ci-in a lak hi.
Tua Zeisu Pasian’ hanciamna leh theihkholhna hangah a kipiak khit ciangin note in migilote’ khut tungah pia-in singlamteh tungah na sisak uh hi.
Ahih hangin sihna in tua pa lencip zo lo ahih ciangin Pasian in sihna gimna a sutkhiat khit ciangin, a hing kiksak hi.
David in tua mi a genkholhna in: ‘Kei in Topa Pasian ka maitang ah a om ka mu tawntung hi, Bang hang hiam i cih leh, ka kikhin theih loh nadingin ka ziat lamah a om hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ka lungdam a, Ka leii zong a nuam hi. Tua tham loin, ka sa in lamenin a nungta ding hi.
Bang hang hiam i cih leh, nangmah in ka Kha, Sihna gam sungah na nusia kei ding hi. Na Misiangtho zong muatna na thuaksak kei ding hi.
Nangmah in nuntakna Lampi nong hilh zo a, Na meel mu-in lungdamna tawh Kei nong dimsak ding hi,’ a ci hi.
“Ute naute aw, pian’na pu David thu a tel takin note kiangah kong gen-inah, tua David si a, a kivuina han in tuni dongin eite kiangah a om hi.

Amah in kamsangpa hi a, ama suan sung pan mi khat ama tokhom tungah a tusak ding hi ci-in Pasian in a kiciam hi cih theikhol ahih ciangin Khazih’ thawhkikna thu a gen hi. Bang hang hiam na cih uh leh, tua Zeisu pen sihna gam sungah kinusia lo a, a sa in zong muatna a thuak kei hi.
Tua Zeisu Pasian in a thawhkiksakna thu kote khempeuh in teci ka hi uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin amah in Pasian’ ziat lamah pahtawina ngah a, Pa kiangah Kha Siangtho kiciamna a ngah khit ciangin, no na muh na zak uh nate hong bua zo hi.
David in vantung ah a kahto kei hi. Ahih hangin amah in: ‘Topa in ka to kumpipa tungah, Na galte nangma khe ngakna-in ka bawl matengin
Ka taklam ah tu in,’ a ci hi.
Tua ahih ciangin note in singlamteh tungah na thah uh Zeisu pen Pasian in Topa leh Khazih a suaksak hi ci-in Israel mi khempeuh in a man takpi thei ta uh hen,” a ci hi.
Tua mite in hih thu a zak uh ciangin a lung uh vut a, “Ute naute aw, bang ka ci hih ding uh hiam?” ci-in Piter a kipan adang sawltakte kiangah a dong uh hi.
Piter in, “Na mawhnate uh kisikkik un la, na vekpi un, mawh kimaisak nadingin Zeisu Khazih’ min tawh kibaptaiz un, Tua bang na hih uh leh, Kha Siangtho’ thupha letsong na ngah ding uh hi.
Bang hang hiam na cih leh, kiciamna in note leh na tate uh ahi zongin, gamla-ah a om Topa i Pasian in a sap ding mi khempeuh ading ahi hi,” ci-in a gen hi.
“Hih gilo khang mite lak panin kigumkhia un,” ci-in thudang tampi tawh hansuah a, thu a hilh hi.
Tua thu a mang mite in kibaptaiz uh a, tua ni-in mi tulthum bang a kibehlap uh hi.
Amaute in sawltakte’ thuhilhna a mang uh a, kipawl khawmna, khomun balnenna leh thungetna a bawl tawntung uh hi.
Mi khempeuh a lau uh a, sawltakte in nalamdang tampi leh lim tampi a bawl uh hi.
Thu-um mi khempeuh pawlkhat bekin a om uh a, amaute neihsa khempeuh gawmin a zangkhawm uh hi.
Amaute in a neih a lamte uh a zuak khit uh ciangin mite’ kisapna bangin a hawmsak uh hi.
Amaute in biakna innpi sungah ni simin lungsim kituakin a om uh a, amau innah anlum balnenin, a siangtho lungdamna tawh anne tuidawn uh a, Pasian a phat uh hi.
Mi khempeuh mai-ah maipha a ngah uh hi. Gupna a ngah mite zong ni simin Pasian in a kibehlapsak hi.
